capabilities: detect paper IDs in notes using a customizable regex
fetch paper metadata (title, authors, journal, publication date)
download and organize PDFs with configurable paths and names
format literature entries with template variables
update the active note, a text selection, or the whole vault
extras: The README states the plugin is adapted from another repository (linked), but the repository's name is not given in the text. Configuration notes warn that Obsidian themes affect how formatted output appears, and that tabs must be pasted from a text editor because Tab shifts focus in the settings UI.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn paper identifiers in a note into formatted literature entries with automatically downloaded PDFs.
summary: Fetches academic paper metadata and PDFs for arXiv, DOI, or bioRxiv IDs written in notes and replaces them with formatted literature entries.
